0022600095.text: The Pacers, at home in their second game of the season, are 1-0 and sit 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East, while the Mavericks are 0-1, 5th in the Southwest and 11th in the West. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Jett Howard (calf soreness), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The Pacers lost 0-2 to Dallas in the 2025-26 season series, including a 134-130 loss in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
